name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and, for A level only, Further Mathematics)
notes: Genetics is available as a Part II (Year 3) specialism within the Natural Sciences Tripos; Chemistry and Biology required; world-leading Genetics Department in Cambridge

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, Biology at B and Chemistry at B, with an A in one of Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); covers molecular genetics, genome biology and evolutionary genetics; Biology required; Roslin Institute proximity (Dolly the sheep)

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology and preferably another science or science-related subject; A in Biology if it is the only science
notes: 3-year BSc and 4-year MBiol; covers genomics, epigenetics and gene therapy; Biology required; Chemistry recommended; MRC Centre for Medical Genomics collaboration

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: AAB, Biology/Human Biology + 1 from Maths, Further Maths, Statistics, Chemistry, Physics; OR AAB including an A in Biology/Human Biology with the other two A levels in any subject
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Biology or Chemistry at grade A
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); covers comparative genomics, epigenetics and gene expression; Biology required; strong cancer genetics research group

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: BBB, including at least two relevant science subjects from Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology; General Studies not accepted
notes: 3-year BSc; home of DNA fingerprinting discovery; covers forensic genetics, clinical genetics and biotechnology; Biology required

name: Queen Mary University of London
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: Swansea University
notes: 3-year BSc; covers medical genetics, developmental genetics and bioinformatics; Biology required; UKRI-funded genomics research; optional placement year
